statement: Mistral raised EUR 3 billion in a Series D at a post-money valuation above EUR 21 billion, with proceeds earmarked in part to scale compute capacity for training.
why: Equity funding is the fuel for model-lab compute purchases; a round of this size signals that financing conditions for a marginal European buyer of accelerators remain open.

impact.mechanism: Fresh equity funds training-cluster procurement, adding to accelerator and cloud-capacity demand, though the release names no dollar amount or GPU count for compute.

evidence.excerpt: €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion
scale its compute capacity for training powerful models

confidence.basis: Company press release, secondary tier, single publisher; compute spend is described only in general language.
